name: 33150 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33150 (Miami) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33150 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33150 (Miami) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 73% of all organizations here have no identified type.
